subject: Eval materials conduit, gating & retention lanes
messages:
From: Sara Hall <sara@ignite-analytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Eval materials exchange: request and constraints

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency and the routing controls. We'd like to run a short evaluation (3-week pilot) using a small slice of our customer-facing prompts + labeled responses to validate quality and throughput on your Dedicated tier.

Quick framing and asks:
- We can share ~4k prompt-response pairs (CSV) and a ~1.2GB sample prompt pack.
- Required constraints: ephemeral sandbox access (no downloads), data retention capped at 30 days, and automatic wipe after the pilot.
- Acceptance criteria: 95% pass on our classification subset (we'll share the eval script), and end-to-end latency P50 < 120ms for a 512-token prompt.
- Need a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lists milestones, acceptance gates, and responsibilities so procurement can sign off.

Attached is a flattened index of the prompt pack (Ignite_SAMPLE_PROMPTPACK_v1.csv). Procurement will want a clear retention lane and proof of delete. Can you confirm if Redwood can support ephemeral keys and a takeback/escrow mechanism for the data?

If you prefer, we can share a draft MAP first; otherwise a Redwood template is fine. Looking to kick off week of Oct 12th.

Thanks,
Sara Hall
Head of Product
Ignite Analytics

Attachment: Ignite_SAMPLE_PROMPTPACK_v1.csv (CSV index of prompt files, 4k rows)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Hall <sara@ignite-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval materials exchange: request and constraints

Sara — really glad the demo landed. We can support the pilot and proposed constraints; below is a concise MAP sketch and a couple of implementation notes to make procurement comfortable.

High-level MAP (provisional)
- Week 0 (prep): NDAs + MAP sign-off (DocuSign), supply of sample index (you've sent).
- Week 1 (ingest & sandbox): Redwood provisions ephemeral sandbox in us-west with token-limited API keys, scoped to Ignite dataset; ingest of provided CSV/prompt pack.
- Weeks 2–3 (eval): Ignite runs acceptance tests; Redwood provides latency/cost telemetry and per-route token breakdowns.
- Week 4 (wrap): Acceptance sign-off or remediation plan; data deletion and audit log export.

Technical gates and controls
- Ephemeral keys: keys expire after 30 days; automatic rotation at 7 days.
- No-export policy: sandbox accounts have download disabled; responses may not be exported wholesale (screened exports allowed for debugging with explicit consent).
- Retention: default TTL = 30 days; immediate irreversible wipe on takeback action. Redwood produces a signed audit event showing object deletion.
- Escrow/Takedown: if Ignite requests, we can place the raw prompt pack into an encrypted customer-controlled S3 bucket (you control the KMS key) — or Redwood handles encrypted storage and provides signed deletion attestations. Let us know preference.

Attachments: I attached a MAP draft (MAP_DRAFT_Ignite_Redwood_v0.9.pdf) with the above milestones and suggested acceptance language. Marissa: can you attach the SOC2 artifact pointer and the ephemeral-key playbook? Karthik: please review suggested SLA for P50 latency and confirm feasibility on Dedicated with a 512-token distribution.

We can ship a DocuSign link for the MAP + DPA once you confirm the escrow preference.

Best,
Evelyn
VP, Partnerships & Alliances
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_DRAFT_Ignite_Redwood_v0.9.pdf (draft MAP with milestones, gating language, and deletion attest template)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: prepare Ignite MAP + security lane checklist

Team — quick internal note to align prior to sending final MAP to Ignite. Sara asked for explicit retention and takeback guarantees and a signed deletion artifact. Please keep replies short; I'll send the final to Ignite by EOD tomorrow.

Items for Marissa (Legal/Onboarding):
- Finalize MAP language (use the draft attached to the thread). Add an explicit acceptance gate: "Ignite will run supplied eval script and sign acceptance form within 5 business days."
- Include clause: "Redwood will provide deletion attestation signed by an authorized Redwood engineer within 48 hours of takeback."
- Confirm who signs the DPA in procurement (we'll loop procurement address when sending DocuSign).

Items for Karthik (SRE/Prod):
- Confirm Dedicated pool sizing and that P50 <120ms for 512-token prompts is realistic under a 50 concurrent-user synthetic workload; include any suggested warm-up/priming step.
- Confirm we can enable ephemeral API keys scoped to a single dataset and set default TTL=30 days, rotation every 7d. Also confirm retention wipe procedure and that we can emit a signed audit event (SHA256 over the deletion log) to Ignite.

Security inputs: link to the SOC2 pointer (internal drive): https://drive.redwood.local/security/soc2-2025-summary (include that in outbound). Also attach ephemeral-key runbook (I'll pull in Marissa's check once ready).

If either of you see regulatory/technical blockers, flag immediately. Otherwise I'll incorporate your edits into MAP_DRAFT and route via DocuSign tomorrow.

—Evelyn
